title: Community practice
idea: Community practice: A genuine recurring activity and participation rules introduce how to join, with consent and conduct visible.
audience: People who need to join activity within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Shared practice matters more than fabricated member totals.
avoidWhen: A fake conversation would impersonate actual participants.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic conversation layout through its join activity priority and explicit commitment contract: Explain joining permissions and moderation without claiming a message was posted.
navigation: Community practice keeps the current join activity context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A genuine recurring activity and participation rules introduce how to join, with consent and conduct visible.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to join activity; shared practice matters more than fabricated member totals.
composition.priority: Explain joining permissions and moderation without claiming a message was posted.

imagery.role: Support the actual join activity context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Prioritize the next real activity and participation requirements over imagery.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the community practice structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no join activity content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Explain joining permissions and moderation without claiming a message was posted.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized join activity content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Explain joining permissions and moderation without claiming a message was posted.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active join activity context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
